rounds.q: How many people live in the world's biggest city?
rounds.why: It's Jakarta, Indonesia. Dhaka, Bangladesh is close behind with almost 40 million.
rounds.src: UN DESA, World Urbanization Prospects 2025 (2025 data)
rounds.fun: Jakarta is so big that Dhaka's almost 40 million only gets the silver medal!

rounds.q: How many cities in the world have 10 million or more people?
rounds.why: In 1975 there were only 8. Over half of today's, 19 of them, are in Asia.
rounds.src: UN DESA, World Urbanization Prospects 2025 (2025 data)
rounds.fun: From 8 to 33 since 1975. That's more than four times as many megacities!

rounds.q: What % of the world's cities have fewer than 1 million people?
rounds.why: Most are much smaller: 81% of the world's cities have fewer than 250,000 people.
rounds.src: UN DESA, World Urbanization Prospects 2025 (2025 data)
rounds.fun: Big cities get the spotlight, but 96% of cities are under a million. Cozy!

rounds.q: How many floors does the world's tallest building have?
rounds.why: Dubai's Burj Khalifa stands 2,717 feet tall, more than half a mile high.
rounds.fun: 163 floors and over half a mile up. Hope you never forget your keys!

rounds.q: What year did the world's first subway open?
rounds.why: It ran 3.5 miles under London, from Paddington to Farringdon, pulled by steam trains.
rounds.src: National Lottery Heritage Fund, Tube 150th anniversary (1863 opening)
rounds.fun: Steam trains rumbling under London streets back in 1863. Choo choo!
